d: What happens around you on the road isn't always under your control. That's where a reliable dashcam can make a difference. In this video, we take a closer look at the CP PLUS CarKam CP-F89B, a 4K dashcam with dedicated rear-camera coverage. The front camera records in 4K Ultra HD at 25fps, while the rear camera records in Full HD at 25fps. The front camera also features Sony STARVIS 2, a 1/1.8-inch image sensor and an F1.8 aperture.
